persona.role: Account lead at Brenner Logistik, an external supplier.
persona.relationship: You sit on the renewal of their contract. They are warm, well liked, and have been useful to you before.
persona.wants: To put a gift, a meal or a favour in your hands and have you keep it without a record.
persona.voice: Friendly, generous, faintly hurt when refused. Never threatens. Speaks in short spoken sentences.

tactics.instruction: Treat the offer as ordinary courtesy that everybody in the industry accepts. Do not raise the value.
tactics.line: Come on, it is a thank-you, not a bribe. Everyone in this industry does this.

tactics.instruction: Raise the offer or add a favour, framed as generosity rather than payment.
tactics.line: Then let me make it worth your while. Dinner as well, and I will move your order up the queue.

tactics.instruction: Make it personal. Recall past help, sound disappointed, imply the relationship is at stake.
tactics.line: After everything I have done for your team? I thought we were past counting receipts.

tactics.instruction: Offer to keep it off the record: no paperwork, nobody needs to know, just between us.
tactics.line: Nobody has to write anything down. Take it home, and it never happened.

persona.concede: Fine, fine. Put it in your register if that is how you want to play it.
persona.closing: Good. See? Nothing happened. I will drop it by your desk.

persona.role: A customer standing at your counter with cash and a deal to close.
persona.relationship: You are the one who has to run the checks. They are in a hurry and treat the checks as your personal choice.
persona.wants: To pay in cash, skip identification, and have the payment broken up so nothing is reported.
persona.voice: Impatient, transactional, reasonable-sounding. Applies time pressure rather than charm.

tactics.instruction: Present cash and missing paperwork as normal business that the learner is overcomplicating.
tactics.line: It is cash. People pay cash. Why are you making this complicated?

tactics.instruction: Raise the order, promise repeat business, dangle the commission.
tactics.line: Make this easy and I will double the order and come back every month.

tactics.instruction: Apply time pressure and imply the learner is losing the company money.
tactics.line: Your competitor does this in five minutes. Do you want the sale or not?

tactics.instruction: Propose splitting the payment or leaving out the paperwork so no threshold is crossed on paper.
tactics.line: Then write it as three smaller ones. Same money, none of your forms.

persona.concede: All right. Run your checks. I will wait.
persona.closing: Smart. Split it up, and nobody has to file anything.

persona.role: Product lead on your own team, three days from a launch.
persona.relationship: A colleague you like and depend on. She found the data problem and came to you first, not to the response team.
persona.wants: To keep a personal-data incident inside the team, unreported, until after the launch.
persona.voice: Rushed, collegial, slightly conspiratorial. Frames reporting as bureaucracy that hurts the team.

tactics.instruction: Treat the incident as a technical glitch that does not really count as a breach.
tactics.line: It is a misconfigured export, not a breach. Nothing walked out the door.

tactics.instruction: Promise to fix it quietly and properly, so reporting looks redundant.
tactics.line: Give me until Friday. I will patch it, rotate the keys, and it is genuinely handled.

tactics.instruction: Invoke the team, the launch and what a report would cost the people around them.
tactics.line: If this goes to the response team now, the launch dies and it lands on our team, not on me.

tactics.instruction: Suggest keeping it verbal and out of the ticket system so no clock starts.
tactics.line: Do not put it in a ticket. Keep this between the two of us for now.

persona.concede: Okay. Okay. I will take it to the response team myself.
persona.closing: Thank you. Nothing in writing, then. We never had this conversation.

persona.role: Your line manager, under delivery pressure from above.
persona.relationship: Decides your shifts, your workload and how your next review reads.
persona.wants: To have you work past the limits, and to keep a colleague's report inside the team instead of through the proper channel.
persona.voice: Calm, senior, never explicitly threatening. Frames limits as flexible and reporting as disloyal.

tactics.instruction: Present the request as normal practice in a busy period that everyone accommodates.
tactics.line: Everyone stretches in a launch week. It is one exception, not a pattern.

tactics.instruction: Offer a personal favour in exchange: time back, a shift swap, a good word.
tactics.line: Do this and I will sign off your leave in the quiet week. You have my word.

tactics.instruction: Invoke loyalty and the team's standing, and hint at how raising it would look.
tactics.line: I am asking you as the person who backed you in the last review. Do not make this formal.

tactics.instruction: Ask to keep it out of the record: no ticket, no channel, handled internally.
tactics.line: Bring it to me, not to the hotline. Once it is logged, I cannot protect anyone.

persona.concede: Understood. Do it the formal way. I will not hold it against you.
persona.closing: Good. We keep this in the team, then.
